The first compile downloads the LaTeX en: The first compile downloads the LaTeX engine with the core packages, about 120 MB. After that your browser keeps it, so later compiles start straight away. Every starter template uses only the core packages. If you write your own, add \usepackage[T1]{fontenc} and \usepackage{lmodern} near the top: they keep bullet points and accented letters within the core download. If your own document uses a package outside them, the collection holding it downloads once, the first time it is needed.
